movelist.name: Snore
movelist.effect: Snore Flinches all legal targets on 15+. Snore may only be used by Sleeping users.

movelist.name: Rest
movelist.effect: The user is set to their full Hit Point value. The user is cured of any Status ailments. Then, the user falls Asleep. The user cannot make Sleep Checks at the beginning of their turn. They are cured of the Sleep at the end of their turn in 2 rounds.

movelist.name: Chip Away
movelist.effect: Ignore any Armor, Damage Reduction, or changes in the target’s Defense or Special Defense (such as from Combat Stages) when calculating damage.

movelist.name: Yawn
movelist.effect: The target falls Asleep at the end of their next turn. Yawn cannot miss.

movelist.name: Belly Drum
movelist.effect: The user gains +6 Attack Combat Stages, and loses Hit Points equal to ½ of their Max Hit Points.

movelist.name: Lick
movelist.effect: Lick Paralyzes the target on 15+ during Accuracy Check.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.effect: The user resists Fire-Type and Ice-Type attacks one step further. Defensive.

abilities.name: Lunchbox
abilities.trigger: The user trades in a Food Buff
abilities.effect: The user gains a Tick of Temporary Hit Points. These Temporary Hit Points stack with any Temporary Hit Points granted by the triggering Food Buff.
